translation.name: Diosa' kiika; Génesis, Éxodo y El Nuevo Testamento

content: Moisésnu Yavé manbatu tsandimi:

Ajke' kayamu unbeenalanuya inchin juu tene tirede, matyu naajulaba Israel chachillachi ajke' kayamu naya inchi tene judeeñu' mitya, tsenmin naa animaalachi llupu ajke' kayamu nala bain tsaren juñu' mitya, timi.

Tsenñu Moisés chachillanu tsandimi: Entsa malu mandenga mandengakidei, entsa malunaa Yavé ya' pudeechi ke', ñulla Egiptonu manda-i' taawasha kemu juu dechuñun mangalaañu. Tsa' mitya entsa malunuya pujkikarentsumi puu panya fityudei.
Ñulla entsa malunu, Abib
chu'chayanu, malundetsuve.

Tsejtu Yavé ñulla' tinbu rukulanu kuwanbera kenu tsuyu tinu tusha, matyu naa Canaánnu sera' jimula bain, Hetnu sera' jimula bain, Amornu sera' jimula bain, Hevenu sera' jimula bain, naa Jebúsnu chumu chachilla bain chuinsha, junga naa chu'pi bain, mishki bain pi ju' shilla' jintsainu tusha ñullanu tajinmalaya, entsa chu'chayanu fandangu kiikenu dejuve.
Mandishpai malutala pan bain fintsumiya pujkikarentsumi putyu tene fifikenu dejuve, tsenmin mandishpai malu tiyanu malunuya Yavéchi fandangu kenu dejuve.

Tsaju' juntsa mandishpai malutala pan bain fintsumiya pujkikarentsumi putyu pan tene fifikenu dejuve. Juntsa malutalaya tiba pujkikaraa juulaya tanan dejutyuve, tsenmin pujkikaantsumi juula bain nukaba tanan dejutyuve.
Juntsa malu chayanmala ñulla' kaillanu entsandinu dejuve: Entsanguilaya lala Egiptonu demalañu, lalanu Yavé tyee kemuwaañu bain mandenganaa tsa tsa dekiyu.

Tsaju' entsaa keñu jumulaa ñulla' tyaapanu, tsa jutyu'ba, llashkapanu mayiiñuu junu tsuve, tsenmalaa Yavé' leinu mandenga' papatinudetsu, matyu Yavé ya' tsamantsaa pudeechee Egiptosha depuren ñullanu mangalaañu.
Tsa' mitya naa-uwanu bain añumee entsaa fandangu kiikenu dejuve, tsanguenu malu janmala.
Tsejtu Yavé ñunu bain, naa ñulla' tinbu rukulanu bain kuwanbera kenu tsuyu timu ju' Canaánnu sera' jimula' tusha ñullanu taji' de-eepunmalaya,
ñuichi ajke' kaya unbeenalanuya Yavéchin juu tene tirenu dejuve, tsenmin animaalanu bain ajke' kailla llupu kayamulanuya tsaren kenu dejuve, matyu juntsalaya Yavéchi tene judeeñu' mitya.

Tsaaren buru kaana ajke' kayamu llupunuya, uvejabaa, tsanguityu'ba, chibubaa vete' tute' keewaanu dejuve, tsaaren mavetei'shu juntsaa, kutu dyaityuinu dejuve. Tsenmin ñuichi ajke' unbeena kayamunu ñuichi mandirenuya, main main jumula' mitya Yavénu ufeenda kuwanu dejuve.

Tsandenna bene ñu' kailla pake'meetu: ¿Entsa tyeenguitaa tsa dekiyu? tinmalaya, ñulla entsandi pakanu dejuve: Yavé lalanu Egipto tusha manda-i' taawasha kemu chachi juu dechuñuren, ya' pudeechi ke' mangalaamuwaave.

Tsejtu faraón meedindyatyu tiya-i' lalanu me-e'laatyuñu, Yavé kumuinchi Egipto' chumu chachillachi ajke' kaya unbee nalanuya detutekive, tsenmin naa animaalachi ajke' kaya llupu jumulanu bain tsaren kemuwaave. Tsenñu' mityaa naaju animaalachiba ajke' kaya nalanuya tute', Yavénu ufeenda keewaawaa dekiyu, tsanguetaa laachi ajke' kaya nalanu livee kikeñungue' manganu, tidei.
Tsa' mitya entsaa keñu jumulaa ñulla' tyaapanu, tsa jutyu'ba, llashkapanu mayiiñuu ju', ñuichi mandengantsumi junu tsuve, Yavé ya' pudeechee lalanu Egiptosha depuren mangalaañu.
Ñivish lura bain, ñi lura bainuyuu jumula

Faraón Israel chachillanu me-e'lare' eeñu, Dios Filistea tusha chumu chachilla' miñushaya miya' jindyumi, naamika juntsa miñushaa kayu deechu' ju' dape' juñu bain, tsaaren tsaamiya Israel chachilla vinguikenuuba faañu bain devinguityu' Egiptosha miinu pensa ne kikenu dejuñu' mityaa tsaami.

Tsejtaa tiba den chutyuin tenasha yatekikaami Ungalala lamaa jinu miñusha miya' jiitu. Tsa' mitya Israel chachilla, Egiptonu demalutu, vinguenun jutyuu suutadulaaba ju' ma bululu uyun tsaaya malu' miila.

Tsejtu Moisés, naa José milla' ujkundaku bain demangalare' manda'mi, matyu José kayu peyai'mujchin Israelnu sera' jimu chachillanu Diosnu paka' tsanguenbera kenu detsuyu tikaatu, José entsandimuwaañu: Uwaindiyu Dios ja' ñullanu la'kanu tsuve; juntsainmala ñulla miintsumiya in ujkundaku mangalare' miidei, timuwaami.
Israel chachilla Sucot tunu demalu' miitu, Etam tushaa miji' kajdiila, tiba den chutyuin tena peepunubi.
Yavé yala' ajkesha jijiindu, mandalaya ñivish lura juunaa miñu keeware' jijiimi, tsenmala kepeya ñi lura juunaa miñu dangare' jijiimi, tsenmalaa naa mandala bain, kepe bain jinudetsu.
Tsaju' naa-uwanuba yalanu baka' miityumujchi mandalaya ñivish lura juuya miya' jijiinmala, kepeya ñi lura juuya yala' ajkesha jijiimi.

footnotes.text: 13.4 Abib chu'chayanaa judíolaya kepe pajtanu keetaditu, yaichiya añunu ajke' chu'chaya juu kuremu jula. Entsa chu'chaya chamiya, marsuchi kejtaa chu'chayabi jumin, abrilchi kejtaa chu'chayabi jiin malu jumunaa entsandi' Abib timu deeve.
